messages:
deploy-bot: Rollout complete for release v2026.4.0 -> prod/uswest2. Starting post-deploy checks: http-heartbeat, shortprompt-synth, kv-prefill. Will post pass/fail here. :white_check_mark:
carlos: noted. I'll kick off the shortprompt-synth job because the changelist touched the rate-limiter config. command:```bash
./tools/smoke_runner --env=prod --probe=shortprompt_synth --concurrency=20 --samples=100
```
priya: FYI the new limiter reduces burst tokens to 60 per client, could bump 429s for short flows if we don't adjust the token-bucket refill. watch p50/p95 for http-heartbeat.
lea: I'm watching dashboards. http-heartbeat p50=22ms p95=380ms currently for /health-check-short. that's high.
sre-oncall: can you paste the heartbeat trace ids? I'll check where 429s are generated (edge vs service).
lea: trace ids: trace-7f3a, trace-7f3b, trace-7f3c. most 429s are coming from edge-rate-limiter cluster-edge-04.
carlos: shortprompt-synth results: 85/100 OK, 15/100 429, synthetic snippet:```
[shortprompt-synth] samples=100 ok=85 fail=15 p95=410ms errs=["429 rate_limited","short-circuit"]
```
priya: 15% 429s > rollback threshold (we treat >10% for heartbeat or synth). recommendation: pin routing in prod/uswest2 to v2026.3.9 and pause further rollout. also open an incident doc.
sre-oncall: confirm. creating incident INC-2026-070: "postdeploy shortflow 429 spike". paging infra oncall.
deploy-bot: Applying routing pin for prod/uswest2 -> v2026.3.9 (reason: post-deploy shortprompt 429=15%). Pin duration=45m. Notifying rollout owners.
lea: after pin: heartbeat p95 dropped to 48ms, shortprompt-synth retried with backoff shows fail 3/100. looks much better.
carlos: pushed a quick rate-limiter hotfix branch that adjusts refill window to 200ms. will test in a canary in eu-west-1 with 5% traffic once we validate the patch.
priya: agree on canary. also add a temporary compensating policy to increase burst allowance for health-check clients only. that should reduce noise for monitoring while we validate.
sre-oncall: incident doc updated with rollback commands, pin commands, and verification checklist. link: https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-070
deploy-bot: Pin active and incident created. If canary passes in 20m we'll schedule an automated unpin and gradual re-roll with the patched image.
lea: thumbs-up. exporting a quick report to the release ticket with probe logs and actions.
